en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of a rocky outcrop in a forested area. At the top of the rock, there is a tall cross and a wooden bridge or walkway. Trees surround the scene, giving it a natural, tranquil atmosphere. Text at the bottom of the postcard identifies the location as 'Bad Landeck' and the feature as 'Schollenstein.' Additional information suggests it was published by F. Koelbel, Landeck.
